description: Every Groq endpoint in your terminal, plus a local ledger that tracks token cost and rate-limit budget.

tools.name: audio_speech
tools.description: Generates audio from the input text. Required: input, model, voice. Optional: response_format (default: mp3), sample_rate (default: 48000), speed (default: 1).

params.name: input
params.description: The text to generate audio for.

params.name: model
params.description: One of the [available TTS models](/docs/text-to-speech).

params.name: response_format
params.description: The format of the generated audio. Supported formats are `flac, mp3, mulaw, ogg, wav`.

params.name: sample_rate
params.description: The sample rate for generated audio

params.name: speed
params.description: The speed of the generated audio.

params.name: voice
params.description: The voice to use when generating the audio. List of voices can be found [here](/docs/text-to-speech).

tools.name: audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes audio into the input language. Required: model. Optional: file, language, prompt (plus 4 more). Returns the new CreateTranscriptionResponseJson.

params.name: file
params.description: The audio file object (not file name) to transcribe, in one of these formats: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, or webm. Either a file or a URL must be provided. Note that the file field is not supported in Batch API requests.

params.name: language
params.description: The language of the input audio. Supplying the input language in [ISO-639-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes) format will improve accuracy and latency.

params.name: model
params.description: ID of the model to use. `whisper-large-v3` and `whisper-large-v3-turbo` are currently available.

params.name: prompt
params.description: An optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment. The [prompt](/docs/speech-text) should match the audio language.

params.name: response_format
params.description: The format of the transcript output, in one of these options: `json`, `text`, or `verbose_json`.

params.name: temperature
params.description: The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. If set to 0, the model will use [log probability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Log_probability) to automatically increase the temperature until certain thresholds are hit.

params.name: timestamp_granularities
params.description: The timestamp granularities to populate for this transcription.

params.name: url
params.description: The audio URL to translate/transcribe (supports Base64URL). Either a file or a URL must be provided. For Batch API requests, the URL field is required since the file field is not supported.

tools.name: audio_translate
tools.description: Translates audio into English. Required: model. Optional: file, prompt, response_format (default: json) (plus 2 more). Returns the new CreateTranslationResponseJson.

params.name: file
params.description: The audio file object (not file name) translate, in one of these formats: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, or webm.

params.name: model
params.description: ID of the model to use. `whisper-large-v3` and `whisper-large-v3-turbo` are currently available.

params.name: prompt
params.description: An optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment. The [prompt](/docs/guides/speech-to-text/prompting) should be in English.

params.name: response_format
params.description: The format of the transcript output, in one of these options: `json`, `text`, or `verbose_json`.

params.name: temperature
params.description: The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. If set to 0, the model will use [log probability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Log_probability) to automatically increase the temperature until certain thresholds are hit.

params.name: url
params.description: The audio URL to translate/transcribe (supports Base64URL). Either file or url must be provided. When using the Batch API only url is supported.

tools.name: batches_cancel
tools.description: Cancels a batch. Required: batch_id. Returns the new Batch.

params.name: batch_id
params.description: The ID of the batch to cancel.

tools.name: batches_create
tools.description: Creates and executes a batch from an uploaded file of requests. Required: completion_window, endpoint, input_file_id. Optional: metadata. Returns the new Batch.

params.name: completion_window
params.description: The time frame within which the batch should be processed. Durations from `24h` to `7d` are supported.

params.name: endpoint
params.description: The endpoint to be used for all requests in the batch. Currently `/v1/chat/completions` is supported.

params.name: input_file_id
params.description: The ID of an uploaded file that contains requests for the new batch. See [upload file](/docs/api-reference#files-upload) for how to upload a file. Your input file must be formatted as a [JSONL file](/docs/batch), and must be uploaded with the purpose `batch`. The file can be up to 100 MB in size.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Optional custom metadata for the batch.

tools.name: batches_get
tools.description: Retrieves a batch. Required: batch_id. Returns the Batch.

params.name: batch_id
params.description: The ID of the batch to retrieve.

tools.name: batches_list
tools.description: Returns a list of the user's batches with their current status and request counts.

tools.name: chat_completions
tools.description: Creates a model response for the given chat conversation. Required: messages, model. Optional: citation_options, compound_custom, custom_template (plus 34 more). Returns the new CreateChatCompletionResponse.

params.name: citation_options
params.description: Whether to enable citations in the response (only supported on models with compound features). Omit unless you need citations.

params.name: compound-custom-models-answering-model
params.description: Custom model to use for answering.

params.name: compound-custom-models-reasoning-model
params.description: Custom model to use for reasoning.

params.name: compound-custom-tools-enabled-tools
params.description: A list of tool names that are enabled for the request.

params.name: custom-template-preserve-system-message-order
params.description: Whether to preserve the order of system messages.

params.name: custom-template-relaxed-message-ordering
params.description: Whether to allow relaxed message ordering in the conversation.

params.name: custom-template-template
params.description: The custom template string to use for formatting messages.

params.name: debug
params.description: output input and output token IDs in xgroq debug field

params.name: disable_tool_validation
params.description: If set to true, groq will return called tools without validating that the tool is present in request.tools. tool_choice=required/none will still be enforced, but the request cannot require a specific tool be used.

params.name: documents
params.description: A list of documents to provide context for the conversation. Each document contains text that can be referenced by the model.

params.name: exclude_domains
params.description: Deprecated: Use search_settings.exclude_domains instead. A list of domains to exclude from the search results when the model uses a web search tool.

params.name: exclude_instance_ids
params.description: For internal use only

params.name: frequency_penalty
params.description: This is not yet supported by any of our models. Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

params.name: function_call
params.description: Deprecated in favor of `tool_choice`. Controls which (if any) function is called by the model. `none` means the model will not call a function and instead generates a message. `auto` means the model can pick between generating a message or calling a function. Specifying a particular function via `{'name': 'my_function'}` forces the model to call that function. `none` is the default when no functions are present. `auto` is the default if functions are present.

params.name: functions
params.description: Deprecated in favor of `tools`. A list of functions the model may generate JSON inputs for.

params.name: include_domains
params.description: Deprecated: Use search_settings.include_domains instead. A list of domains to include in the search results when the model uses a web search tool.

params.name: include_reasoning
params.description: Whether to include reasoning in the response. If true, the response will include a `reasoning` field. If false, the model's reasoning will not be included in the response. This field is mutually exclusive with `reasoning_format`.

params.name: logit_bias
params.description: This is not yet supported by any of our models. Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

params.name: logprobs
params.description: This is not yet supported by any of our models. Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the `content` of `message`.

params.name: max_completion_tokens
params.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion. The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by the model's context length.

params.name: max_tokens
params.description: Deprecated in favor of `max_completion_tokens`. The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion. The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by the model's context length.

params.name: messages
params.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

params.name: metadata
params.description: This parameter is not currently supported.

params.name: model
params.description: ID of the model to use. For details on which models are compatible with the Chat API, see available [models](https://console.groq.com/docs/models)

params.name: n
params.description: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message. Note that the current moment, only n=1 is supported. Other values will result in a 400 response.

params.name: parallel_tool_calls
params.description: Whether to enable parallel function calling during tool use.

params.name: presence_penalty
params.description: This is not yet supported by any of our models. Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

params.name: reasoning_effort
params.description: qwen3 models support `none` to disable reasoning and `default` or null to use the model default. qwen/qwen3.8-27b additionally supports `low`, `medium`, and `high`. Its default is `none`; `high` selects the model's native `xhigh` mode. openai/gpt-oss-20b and openai/gpt-oss-120b support 'low', 'medium', or 'high'. 'medium' is the default value.

params.name: reasoning_format
params.description: Specifies how to output reasoning tokens This field is mutually exclusive with `include_reasoning`.

params.name: response_format
params.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output. Setting to `{ 'type': 'json_schema', 'json_schema': {...} }` enables Structured Outputs which ensures the model will match your supplied JSON schema. `json_schema` response format is only available on [supported models](https://console.groq.com/docs/structured-outputs#supported-models). Setting to `{ 'type': 'json_object' }` enables the older JSON mode, which ensures the message the model generates is valid JSON. Using `json_schema` is preferred for models that support it.

params.name: search-settings-country
params.description: Name of country to prioritize search results from (e.g., 'united states', 'germany', 'france').

params.name: search-settings-exclude-domains
params.description: A list of domains to exclude from the search results.

params.name: search-settings-include-domains
params.description: A list of domains to include in the search results.

params.name: search-settings-include-images
params.description: Whether to include images in the search results.

params.name: seed
params.description: If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same `seed` and parameters should return the same result. Determinism is not guaranteed, and you should refer to the `system_fingerprint` response parameter to monitor changes in the backend.

params.name: service_tier
params.description: The service tier to use for the request. Defaults to `on_demand`. - `auto` will automatically select the highest tier available within the rate limits of your organization. - `flex` uses the flex tier, which will succeed or fail quickly.

params.name: stop
params.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens. The returned text will not contain the stop sequence.

params.name: store
params.description: This parameter is not currently supported.

params.name: stream
params.description: If set, partial message deltas will be sent. Tokens will be sent as data-only [server-sent events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events#Event_stream_format) as they become available, with the stream terminated by a `data: [DONE]` message. [Example code](/docs/text-chat#streaming-a-chat-completion).

params.name: stream-options-include-usage
params.description: If set, an additional chunk will be streamed before the `data: [DONE]` message. The `usage` field on this chunk shows the token usage statistics for the entire request, and the `choices` field will always be an empty array. All other chunks will also include a `usage` field, but with a null value.

params.name: temperature
params.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. We generally recommend altering this or top_p but not both.

params.name: tool_choice
params.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. `none` means the model will not call any tool and instead generates a message. `auto` means the model can pick between generating a message or calling one or more tools. `required` means the model must call one or more tools. Specifying a particular tool via `{'type': 'function', 'function': {'name': 'my_function'}}` forces the model to call that tool. `none` is the default when no tools are present. `auto` is the default if tools are present.

params.name: tools
params.description: A list of tools the model may call. Currently, only functions are supported as a tool. Use this to provide a list of functions the model may generate JSON inputs for. A max of 128 functions are supported.

params.name: top_logprobs
params.description: This is not yet supported by any of our models. An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability. `logprobs` must be set to `true` if this parameter is used.

params.name: top_p
params.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature but not both.

params.name: user
params.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help us monitor and detect abuse.

tools.name: embeddings_create
tools.description: Creates an embedding vector representing the input text. Required: input, model. Optional: encoding_format (default: float), user. Returns array of Embedding.

params.name: encoding_format
params.description: The format to return the embeddings in. Can only be `float` or `base64`.

params.name: input
params.description: Input text to embed, encoded as a string or array of tokens. To embed multiple inputs in a single request, pass an array of strings or array of token arrays. The input must not exceed the max input tokens for the model, cannot be an empty string, and any array must be 2048 dimensions or less.

params.name: model
params.description: ID of the model to use.

params.name: user
params.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help us monitor and detect abuse.

params.name: file_id
params.description: The ID of the file to use for this request.

tools.name: files_download
tools.description: Returns the contents of the specified file. Required: file_id.

params.name: file_id
params.description: The ID of the file to use for this request.

tools.name: files_list

tools.name: files_retrieve

params.name: file_id
params.description: The file to retrieve

tools.name: files_upload
tools.description: Upload a file that can be used across various endpoints. The Batch API only supports `.jsonl` files up to 100 MB in size. The input also has a specific required. Required: file, purpose. Returns the new File.

params.name: file
params.description: The File object (not file name) to be uploaded.

params.name: purpose
params.description: The intended purpose of the uploaded file. Use 'batch' for [Batch API](/docs/api-reference#batches).

tools.name: fine_tunings_create
tools.description: Creates a new fine tuning for the already uploaded files This endpoint is in closed beta. Optional: base_model, input_file_id, name (plus 1 more). Returns the new ReadFineTuningResponse.

params.name: base_model

params.name: input_file_id

params.name: name

params.name: type

tools.name: fine_tunings_get

params.name: id

tools.name: fine_tunings_list

params.name: model

tools.name: models_list

tools.name: models_retrieve

params.name: model
params.description: The model to get

tools.name: reranking_create
tools.description: Given a query and a list of documents, returns the documents ranked by their relevance to the query. The documents are scored and sorted in descending order of relevance. Required: docs, model, query. Optional: instruction.

params.name: docs
params.description: An array of documents to rank. Each document is a string containing the text content. Maximum of 100 documents per request.

params.name: instruction
params.description: Optional instruction to guide the reranking process. If not provided, a default instruction will be used.

params.name: model
params.description: ID of the reranking model to use.

params.name: query
params.description: The search query to rank documents against.

tools.name: responses_create
tools.description: Creates a model response for the given input. Required: input, model. Optional: instructions, max_output_tokens, metadata (plus 12 more). Returns the new CreateResponseResponse.

params.name: input
params.description: Text input to the model, used to generate a response.

params.name: instructions
params.description: Inserts a system (or developer) message as the first item in the model's context.

params.name: max_output_tokens
params.description: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a response, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Custom key-value pairs for storing additional information. Maximum of 16 pairs.

params.name: model
params.description: ID of the model to use. For details on which models are compatible with the Responses API, see available [models](https://console.groq.com/docs/models)

params.name: parallel_tool_calls
params.description: Enable parallel execution of multiple tool calls.

params.name: reasoning-effort
params.description: Level of reasoning effort. Supported values: `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`. `none` disables reasoning and is supported only by Qwen3.8 models. Lower graded values provide faster responses with less reasoning depth. When omitted, the default is `none` for Qwen3.8 and `medium` for GPT-OSS models.

params.name: service_tier
params.description: Specifies the latency tier to use for processing the request.

params.name: store
params.description: Response storage flag. Note: Currently only supports false or null values.

params.name: stream
params.description: Enable streaming mode to receive response data as server-sent events.

params.name: temperature
params.description: Controls randomness in the response generation. Range: 0 to 2. Lower values produce more deterministic outputs, higher values increase variety and creativity.

params.name: text-format
params.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output.

params.name: tool_choice
params.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. `none` means the model will not call any tool and instead generates a message. `auto` means the model can pick between generating a message or calling one or more tools. `required` means the model must call one or more tools. Specifying a particular tool via `{'type': 'function', 'function': {'name': 'my_function'}}` forces the model to call that tool. `none` is the default when no tools are present. `auto` is the default if tools are present.

params.name: tools
params.description: List of tools available to the model. Currently supports function definitions only. Maximum of 128 functions.

params.name: top_p
params.description: Nucleus sampling parameter that controls the cumulative probability cutoff. Range: 0 to 1. A value of 0.1 restricts sampling to tokens within the top 10% probability mass.

params.name: truncation
params.description: Context truncation strategy. Supported values: `auto` or `disabled`.

params.name: user
params.description: Optional identifier for tracking end-user requests. Useful for usage monitoring and compliance.

novel_features.name: Rate-limit budget
novel_features.description: See remaining per-model request/token budget from every API call, with reset windows.

novel_features.name: Cost ledger analytics
novel_features.description: Aggregate token and dollar spend from your local completion history, grouped by model or day.

novel_features.name: Multi-model prompt runner
novel_features.description: Run one prompt across several models and rank them by latency, tokens/sec, usage, and cost.

novel_features.name: Batch request pre-flight
novel_features.description: Validate every line of a .jsonl batch request file against the endpoint schema and estimate tokens/cost before uploading.

novel_features.name: Batch results diagnosis
novel_features.description: Tabulate a completed batch's per-line status codes and errors, highlighting retry-worthy failures.

novel_features.name: Paced bulk audio runner
novel_features.description: Transcribe, translate, or synthesize speech over many audio files with rate-limit-aware pacing and a results manifest.
